svg.title: phishMe
svg.desc: phishMe: a leakage-aware phishing detection pipeline. 46,786 de-duplicated rows split 28,068 / 9,356 / 9,362, disjoint by registrable domain. Paired bootstrap with 10,000 resamples. The linear model runs on-device in a Chrome extension under a 25 MB and 250 ms p95 budget.

g.text: TRK 01 / FEATURED · PYTHON · LIGHTGBM · CHROME MV3
Does a model that looks near-perfect on its own benchmark
still work on data it has never seen? A leakage-aware
phishing pipeline, with a linear model that scores on-device.

svg.text: ILLUSTRATIVE FEED · CROSS-DATASET RESULTS DO NOT YET GENERALIZE
